name: QA & Build Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]

jobs:
  quality-assurance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      # Step 1: Grab the code from the repository
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      # Step 2: Set up a Node environment to run QA tools
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      # Step 3: Install a lightweight HTML linter (QA tool)
      - name: Install HTMLHint
        run: npm install -g htmlhint

      # Step 4: Run the automated QA check on your index file
      - name: Run Static Code Analysis
        run: htmlhint index.html.html
        
      # Step 5: (Simulated) Upload Artifact ready for deployment
      - name: Upload Build Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: terencys-web-build
          path: index.html.html
